pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions with jagged, non-linear edge boundaries and irregular polygonal shapes. Edge gradients show transition zones of several pixels. Relative spatial area is highest in the mid-flank region, decreasing toward the ventral and limb regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous network. Intersection nodes are predominantly tri-radial. Continuity is maintained across the entire visible surface, with pixel thickness increasing in the upper flank areas compared to the lower abdomen.
